description.short: Understand connectivity health before and during Teams meetings.
description.full: SignalTuner helps meeting participants and support teams understand connectivity problems without leaving Microsoft Teams. View your connectivity dashboard, monitor Microsoft Teams service incidents, and share connectivity status with other signed-in SignalTuner participants in a meeting. Request five-minute connectivity analyses and review meeting history. A SignalTuner account is required; create an account in the app. Live device telemetry and device analyses require the SignalTuner desktop app on the computer being monitored. Reports use credits, and analyses of other participants follow account permissions and device-consent rules. Meeting invitations require the SignalTuner bot to be installed in the meeting chat; channel-meeting invitations are not supported. For setup assistance, contact support@signaltuner.com.
